AlternateTargets: fail to distinguish good from bad
SearchAliases: does not know good from bad
no sense of good and bad
Senses.Note: The phrase is an ordinary judgment of failed discrimination that Chan masters turn into a sharp public rebuke for mishandling a case, display, or answer.

Occurrences.Kwic: 示眾云：我見百丈和尚不識好惡。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X79/X79n1557.xml). Essential Compendium of the United Lamp. Exact utterer: Muzhou Daoming. Muzhou Daoming says that Baizhang did not know good from bad before recounting Baizhang’s staff action.

Occurrences.Kwic: 與麼說話，可謂無夢說夢，和泥合水，撒屎撒尿，不識好惡。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X83/X83n1578.xml). Record Pointing at the Moon. Exact utterer: Ciming Chuyuan. Ciming Chuyuan calls the preceding exposition dream-talk and a failure to know good from bad. Exact utterer: Shishuang Chuyuan (Ciming Chuyuan).

Occurrences.Kwic: 黃檗琦云：世尊陞座，慙惶殺人；文殊白椎，不識好惡。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1296.xml). Compilation of the School Gate’s “Raising Old Cases”. Exact utterer: Yinyuan Longqi. Yinyuan Longqi says that Manjushri’s formal announcement failed to know good from bad.

Occurrences.Kwic: 更有老底不識好惡，對云：將謂仙陀客。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1297.xml). Dharma Grove of the Tradition’s Mirror. Exact utterer: Xuedou Chongxian. Xuedou Chongxian rebukes an old respondent who answers a case without knowing good from bad.

Occurrences.Kwic: 有一般不識好惡禿奴，便即見神見鬼，指東劃西，好晴好雨
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J23/J23nB134.xml). Recorded Sayings of the Five Houses (Selections). Exact utterer: Linji Yixuan. Linji Yixuan condemns performers who cannot distinguish good from bad yet make supernatural displays and predictions.

Occurrences.Kwic: 恁麼說話。太殺壓良為賤。不識好惡。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1998A.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dahui Pujue. Exact utterer: Dahui Zonggao. Dahui Zonggao judges his own preceding formulation too demeaning and unable to distinguish good from bad.

Senses.Explanation: Not knowing good from bad is a verdict on failed discrimination: the records use it when someone mishandles an encounter, mistakes explanation for accomplishment, or performs showily without judgment. Muzhou Daoming applies it to Baizhang’s staff action, while Ciming Chuyuan uses it against an elaborate exposition and Xuedou Chongxian against a stock answer. Linji Yixuan directs it at supernatural performance, while Dahui Zonggao turns it against an overdrawn formulation.
